messages:
Anya (Design): quick check 1: bulk-delete of Pools: should we show per-row inline errors (permission/login issues) immediately, or surface a single top-level failure summary after submit? goal: scanability + single keyboard flow. Olivia (PM): personally prefer one summary for bulk ops so users dont have to hunt. include anchors that jump to failing rows if they want detail. Mike (Eng): summary + row anchors makes sense technically. main ask: when submit fails, move focus to the summary and ensure tab order is predictable. keyboard-only users shouldn't get lost. Sam (DevEx): also add small inline previews for the first 2-3 failures (collapsed by default). reduces context switching. avoid auto-scrolling too aggressively. Anya (Design): good note. for screen readers, should we announce "3 failures" and then allow link navigation into rows? a11y-bot: suggested pattern: set focus to a status container with aria-live and role=status. Provide links with aria-controls to expand details. Example snippet: ```
3 items failed
View issue for row 12
Permission denied: delete_pool
``` Anya (Design): thanks, thats clear. new thread: typed confirm for destructive actions? full typed confirmation vs a required checkbox + stronger toast. Olivia (PM): typed-confirm reduces accidents but slows power users. consider making typed-confirm required only for org-owned pools or if the pool has > X members. Mike (Eng): implementation notes: if we use typed-confirm, autofocus the input, allow paste, use `autocomplete=off` and ensure matching is exact (trim whitespace). keyboard flow: primary CTA should be disabled until match. Sam (DevEx): prefer disabling CTA until validate-match, with an accessible hint under the input showing match status. avoid keeping users trapped in modal if keyboard focus is misrouted. Anya (Design): microcopy tweak idea: instead of "Type the pool name to confirm", use "Enter the pool name to permanently delete this pool." adds severity. a11y-bot: also recommend: set `aria-invalid` on the typed input when mismatch, and use `aria-describedby` to point at helper text. show clear error text like "Names do not match." Ensure focus is not stolen repeatedly by validation. Olivia (PM): decision proposal: hybrid error surface (top summary with anchors + inline expand for first 3 fails). typed-confirm: opt-in for org-owned/high-impact pools; default to checkbox for smaller ones. implementation notes captured by Mike/Sam. Mike (Eng): ack, will add focus management tickets and a short rollout plan. Sam (DevEx): I'll add keyboard acceptance criteria to the PR template and check the aria attributes. Anya (Design): I'll upload mocks for the hybrid summary + inline preview and the typed-confirm modal copy update. tagging @Mike (Eng) @Sam (DevEx) @Olivia (PM) for review when ready. Olivia (PM): thanks, will update the spec and call out the conditional rule for typed-confirm. Mike (Eng): will review mocks.
